_comment: SigMap config for VectFox. Tuned 2026-07-30 to fix coverage grade D (38%).
_outputs_comment: ONLY copilot. The 'claude' adapter targets CLAUDE.md, which is hand-maintained project instructions loaded every session — SigMap must never write signatures into it. codex/gemini are unused here.
_exclude_comment: srcDirs stays auto-detected. 'tests' is excluded from SIGNATURE EXTRACTION only: 35 test files yielded 41 signatures total (most yield 0) while consuming 35 of 123 file slots, which is what starved real source files out of the budget. Test-coverage detection uses testDirs below and is unaffected.
_srcDirs_comment: Pinned because auto-detection is unstable here: excluding 'tests' caused it to pull in Migration/ (2 one-off scripts) instead, while never finding providers/. These six are the actual shipped source roots.
_maxSigsPerFile_comment: Raised from 25: collection-metadata.js, core-vector-api.js, eventbase-store.js and collection-loader.js all sat at exactly 25, i.e. capped. Net gain was modest (+8 symbols repo-wide) but it removes an arbitrary ceiling on this repo's largest modules at negligible token cost.
_budget_comment: effective = clamp(totalSigTokens x coverageTarget, 4000, modelContextLimit x maxTokensHeadroom). Was 0.80 target against a 128k assumption -> 18,333 budget vs 22,707 of content -> 48 files dropped.
_strategy_comment: 'full' keeps one always-loaded file. Revisit 'per-module' only if the single file stops fitting the budget — it splits output per srcDir, which costs an extra lookup step per question.
_testCoverage_comment: Function-level tested/untested hints. Cheap and directly useful when deciding whether a change needs new tests.
_impactRadius_comment: Reverse-dependency hints in file headers ('used by: ...'). Worth the tokens in a codebase where placement/import direction is a hard rule.
